lines: Aaj mujhe ehsaas hua hai apni shikasta-paai ka
couplets.en: Only today have I felt how badly my feet have failed me.

lines: Dekh ke mujhko duniya waale kehne lage hain deewaana
couplets.en: People take one look at me and call me mad.

lines: Aaj wahaan hai ishq jahaan kuchh khauf nahin ruswaai ka
couplets.en: Love has come so far that it no longer fears disgrace.

lines: Chhod dein rasm-e-khud-nigari ko, tod dein apna imaan
couplets.en: Let me turn from my own reflection and break with my faith.

lines: Khaak kiye deta hai zaalim roop teri angdaai ka
couplets.en: The cruel grace of your stretch reduces me to dust.

lines: Maine ziya husn ko bakhshi, uska to koi zikr nahin
couplets.en: I lent your beauty its light, and no one speaks of it.

lines: Lekin ghar ghar mein charcha hai aaj teri raanaai ka
couplets.en: Yet today every household speaks of your radiance.

lines: Ahl-e-hawas ab ghabraate hain, doob ke bahr-e-gham mein, Shakeel
couplets.en: Now that they are drowning in sorrow, Shakeel, those who chased pleasure are afraid.

lines: Pehle na tha bechaaron ko andaaza gehraai ka
couplets.en: The poor souls had no idea how deep the waters were.

lines: Door hai manzil, raahein mushkil, aalam hai tanhaai ka
couplets.en: The journey's end is far, the roads are hard, and there is loneliness all around.
